decision.release_scope: Targeted inferred-filter recall fixes and strict malformed-candidate isolation; not a complete retrieval-quality or V1 gate pass.
basis: The same frozen 23-turn protocol completed without HTTP, action, or verification failures; selected anchors improved 16/19 to 19/19.
Confirmed main results increased 39/48 to 69/80 (81.25% to 86.25%); SMS recall and tool-upgrade target recall recovered.
Broad guards remain 34/35 confirmed. Of ten old guard occurrences not on the returned page, five passed both strict judgments and were page-cutoff. No old guard positive was scope-critic rejected.
Real pilot malformed-row isolation returned a valid subset with an explicit user-visible incompleteness warning; fatal/global/identity paths remain bounded by synthetic evidence.
An independent implementation review and a separate quality-tradeoff review support this scoped increment; evidence VERIFIED alone is not the release judgment.
accepted_material_limits: Nonempty-query macro precision declined from 89.1667% (18 turns) to 87.9825% (19 turns). Micro improvement is not uniform per-query improvement.
Six neighbor and five uncertain returned occurrences remain; H01 remains open.
Fresh 39 positives retain 36; historical 38 retain 33; guard 34 retain 24. These sets have different scopes and are not merged into a Recall metric.
Two payment positives were primary false negatives; three broad Agent positives were primary false negatives. Candidate-pool and invalid-quote losses remain separately recorded.
Harness named-anchor coverage is still 1/3 on the requested first page; the other two passed both judgments and were page-cutoff.
SEARCH median increased 41.134s to 49.008s; main operation logs increased 70 to 89. Recorded operations are not assumed to be billable request counts.
Only one of three frozen negative challenge rows entered the final candidate pool; other nonreturns are not demonstrated reranker rejections.
Development-exposed Agent labels, provider revision auto, and finite candidate Top50 do not prove human Gold, fixed model weights, whole-corpus Recall, or unseen generalization.
All six pre-existing V1 quality blockers remain. This release does not mark their gates passed.
The tested frozen image excludes concurrent COUNT/ANSWER workspace additions. Those edits are preserved; the 668-pass/1-skip snapshot does not verify the later additions.
deployment_preconditions: Production API must still be the c348ec baseline image and have no active query lease.
Deploy the exact tested image and verify its 21 installed file hashes, revisions, model gate, and health.
Preserve current UI baseline, worker, corpus, memory, and concurrent workspace edits.
